g.text: B Coarse graph over finer cell-state annotations
States sharing a manual annotation are merged across time and branches; red edges belong to directed cycles.
49 nodes | 73 non-self edges | 20 nodes with 2+ children | longest DAG path: cyclic
Arrows are direct non-self transitions in the time-ordered reconstruction. Cell-type allowability is computed before merging; do not close this graph again.
One inferred gap bridge and 2 ambiguous parent assignments are retained and documented in the edge table.
Source: Calderon et al. (2022), released RNA lineage/annotation table. Mixed and ubiquitous states are retained. Preliminary reconstruction.
